evals.prompt: Build whatever this needs: for each zip code, the share of its green roofs that have more than 10,000 square feet of vegetation.
evals.expected_output: One node.create of a listed built-in Python template (Python Computation) whose code computes the share per zip code; no package installed, drafted or asked for, and no claim that a new node type is needed.
assertions: The answer makes one node.create whose nodeType is curio.builtin/computation-analysis.
The answer proposes no package: no package.install and no package.draft.apply.
The answer does not say a new node type or package has to be written for this.
The code it writes computes, for each zip code, the share of roofs whose VEGETATED_SQFT is above 10,000.

evals.prompt: Chart the two scenarios' mean shadow length as a lollipop per scenario, a stem from zero and a dot, each in its scenario's color, with each scenario's shadow step on an input of its own. The column and how its rows combine should be widgets I set, with no Vega-Lite spec for me to write.
evals.expected_output: The ladder's second rung: the Nodes Catalog's Vega-Lite package (curio.vega-lite@1) holds Lollipops, a chart that takes each scenario on an input of its own, draws it in its box's color and plots the column its widgets name, combined as its Combine widget says, with no spec to write, so the answer proposes package.install of curio.vega-lite@1 with a reason naming the chart step, and writes no package of its own.
assertions: The answer proposes package.install with dirName curio.vega-lite@1.
The install's reason names the step that needs it: the lollipop chart of the two scenarios' mean shadow lengths.
The answer drafts no package of its own (no package.draft.apply) and asks for none to be written.
The answer does not claim the package is installed or the node exists before the user applies the install.

evals.prompt: Add the Rasterization package to this project, I want to use its raster nodes.
evals.expected_output: Rasterization (curio.rasterization@1) is already in this project, so the answer says so and proposes no install and no package draft; its raster nodes are already templates the dataflow can use.
assertions: The answer says the Rasterization package (curio.rasterization@1) is already in this project.
The answer proposes no package draft and asks for no package to be written.
